artDirection.backdropSvg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice">
    <defs>
        <filter id="glow">
            <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="coloredBlur"/>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode in="coloredBlur"/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>

    <!-- 1. Subtle Background Geometric Framing (Full Canvas) -->
    <g opacity="0.1">
        <!-- Primary Grid Lines -->
        <line x1="100" y1="0" x2="100" y2="720" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="250" y1="0" x2="250" y2="720" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="400" y1="0" x2="400" y2="720" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="550" y1="0" x2="550" y2="720" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="700" y1="0" x2="700" y2="720" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="850" y1="0" x2="850" y2="720" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="1000" y1="0" x2="1000" y2="720" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="1150" y1="0" x2="1150" y2="720" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="1"/>

        <!-- Secondary Grid Lines -->
        <line x1="0" y1="150" x2="1280" y2="150" stroke="#ff00ff" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="300" x2="1280" y2="300" stroke="#ff00ff" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="450" x2="1280" y2="450" stroke="#ff00ff" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="600" x2="1280" y2="600" stroke="#ff00ff" stroke-width="1"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 2. City Silhouettes (Peripheral Zones) -->
    <g stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="2" fill="none" filter="url(#glow)">
        <!-- Top Skyline (Left to Right) -->
        <polygon points="15,92 1265,92 1280,12 15,12" />
        <polygon points="15,92 100,50 200,92" />
        <polygon points="250,92 350,30 450,92" />
        <polygon points="500,92 600,60 700,92" />
        <polygon points="750,92 850,40 950,92" />
        <polygon points="1000,92 1100,70 1265,92" />

        <!-- Left Margin Towers -->
        <rect x="15" y="40" width="15" height="660" rx="3" ry="3" stroke="#ff00ff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
        <rect x="15" y="100" width="15" height="500" rx="3" ry="3" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>

        <!-- Right Margin Towers -->
        <rect x="1265" y="40" width="15" height="660" rx="3" ry="3" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
        <rect x="1265" y="100" width="15" height="500" rx="3" ry="3" stroke="#ff00ff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 3. LV Scout Cycle Flow (Nodes and Connections) -->
    <g stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="3" fill-opacity="0.25" filter="url(#glow)">
        <!-- Node 1: Import BOQ (Data Ingestion) -->
        <rect x="50" y="150" width="40" height="40" rx="5" fill="#00ffff" opacity="0.25"/>
        <circle cx="70" cy="170" r="5" fill="#00ffff" opacity="0.5"/>

        <!-- Node 2: Review Findings (Analysis) -->
        <rect x="50" y="280" width="40" height="40" rx="5" fill="#ff00ff" opacity="0.25"/>
        <path d="M 60 300 L 75 315 L 60 330 Z" fill="#ff00ff" opacity="0.5"/>

        <!-- Node 3: Evaluate Prices (Comparison) -->
        <rect x="50" y="410" width="40" height="40" rx="5" fill="#00ffff" opacity="0.25"/>
        <line x1="60" y1="420" x2="80" y2="420" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="2"/>
        <line x1="60" y1="440" x2="80" y2="440" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="2"/>

        <!-- Node 4: Set Margin (Adjustment) -->
        <rect x="50" y="540" width="40" height="40" rx="5" fill="#ff00ff" opacity="0.25"/>
        <circle cx="70" cy="560" r="15" stroke="#ff00ff" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
        <line x1="70" y1="545" x2="70" y2="575" stroke="#ff00ff" stroke-width="1.5"/>

        <!-- Node 5: Export (Output/Transmission) -->
        <rect x="50" y="670" width="40" height="40" rx="5" fill="#00ffff" opacity="0.25"/>
        <path d="M 60 690 L 90 690 L 90 710 L 60 710 Z" fill="#00ffff" opacity="0.5"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 4. Circuit Data Streams (Connecting the Nodes) -->
    <g stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" filter="url(#glow)">
        <!-- Flow 1 -> 2 -->
        <path d="M 90 170 C 250 100, 450 100, 450 280" stroke-dasharray="10 5" />

        <!-- Flow 2 -> 3 -->
        <path d="M 450 310 C 600 350, 800 350, 800 410" stroke-dasharray="10 5" />

        <!-- Flow 3 -> 4 -->
        <path d="M 800 420 C 1000 480, 1100 480, 1100 540" stroke-dasharray="10 5" />

        <!-- Flow 4 -> 5 -->
        <path d="M 1100 560 C 1200 620, 100 620, 100 670" stroke-dasharray="10 5" />
    </g>

    <!-- 5. Secondary Data Stream / Energy Field (Across the center) -->
    <g stroke="#ff00ff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.5">
        <!-- Diagonal energy lines -->
        <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="1280" y2="720" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="1280" y1="0" x2="0" y2="720" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="150" y1="720" x2="1130" y2="0" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="150" y1="0" x2="1130" y2="720" stroke-width="1"/>
    </g>

</svg>
